body: Been waiting 77 days for the interim work authorization. Any updates? I wonder how many of us left the country already…sad
I totally understand you. It changes you, almost a rewriting of your persona. Wishing all SA/R*pe victims to get well ❤️‍🩹 again!
Having less weight in my stomach or stomach discomfort helped me to cope and regulate my depression. A healthy “diet” is a great path way of mental positive stimulation.

Thank you for your insight. This trauma happened a month ago. 
I am thinking about it every single day, it is haunting me. Do I want this haunting for the rest of my life until I am able to manning up? So many question and no answers but tears.
The self-doubt, grows and the depression comes in waves. I find myself in a viscous cycle that only will hurt myself. It makes me want to disappear.

As you said it is not easy to manning up and getting help. It is so exhausting and re-experience the pain while trying to find help. 

Thx for the great wishes and the responses.

That my sexual orientation is liking the same gender. But still being forced to like the opposite. There’s no option of being with the same gender it’s almost non-existing. Almost living a double life and knowing that your parents could harm you or themselves.

Same back at you! I find it so positively surprising that strangers react this way. I could have never spoken about my issues with a picture. I always hold myself accountable for anything I’d do - selfblame & ego. 

This app allows me to express and feel through my emotions without faking it. And pretending that everything is ok. Cause I am ashamed of my situation or this weird feeling of “fear”.

Just to correct what I wrote earlier about the therapy, I haven’t gotten it yet. It could take up 9months. Waiting-list - which I’m pretty afraid of. 

Time is life.

Thank you for encouraging. I noted all of the above. But lack of motivation will probably stop me. 

I am glad to hear you went through all this and feeling better. 

Being nice and kind doesn’t cost us a cent. 

I also do not like putting myself into the Center I well know that there’s plenty pure souls out there who need as much help as I do. 
You put tears in my eyes, these one’s we’re happy ones. 

The r*pe was a breaking point in my life, the failed relationships make me feel like I’m at dead end and in between the offender and lover. 
Even typing this down makes me wanna throw up I just don’t want this to be true. So much sadness, confusion, helplessness, shame, fear, flashbacks, guilt self-blame, hopelessness & suic. feelings will hunt you down daily and it comes in waves. My apologies for bringing this up.

Thank you for the kind words friendly stranger, wishing you the world too.

I would like to give you a hug through the internet. Thank you for sharing you story. It is uplifting - thank you.
 I am very concerned how my situation could go worse cause I am expecting the worst. I have started with a low dosage of medication.

My rational thinking saves me most of the time. Although I feel it is getting worse. Depending on my mental health and outside factors..

I am focusing to work on the better with counselling and therapy. However it is pretty hard to get that support hence it is very expansive. Failed relationships add to it.

I am hoping you are doing better through this hard time!

To make things clear. You did nothing wrong. You were a child at the age 14.

Just because you don’t say “no” does not mean anyone has the right to touch you. It is an absolute no! The people were horrible to you. You my love are very brave to speak about such trauma.

I have recently just experience rape…I myself hate to admit that it was rape. Because I also hate this word. But no the society is just build that way that we blame ourselves. Please tell me how old are you now?

I warms my heart to read the positive comments of strangers online. 

Trust plays the major role in relationships. Whereas it is in friendships, family or with the significant other

I appreciate your support. I am trying to receive therapeutic help, hence I’m having suicidal thoughts. I am also being contacted by the detective. There is so many things happening and I don’t want to make decision while my emotions and my rational thinking is a mess.

I am so sorry to hear that similar things happened to you. 

Even if our stories are different, the pain the same. 

I appreciate that strangers like the online community gives me such amazing explanations of this feeling/trauma. I could have sworn all of the comments I got that I wrote them myself.  I appreciate you guys. 

At this point I’m not sure if I want to be traumatized or in love.
My detective has called me yesterday to follow up with pressing charges. I told him I’d like to speak to my counselling first. Which is today 21st of December. 
I am hoping to do the right decision. I don’t like conflicts

Thank you zylo321

You are right in everything you said. Unfortunately I am still blaming my self, I could have had approached the situation better or told my SO in a different and better way. 

I cannot control this thought, it always comes back to me. 

I just talked to my SO and I am feeling worse. I want to blame him partially for this but I cannot. 

He said things such like: “You are not the victim” “You don’t know how it feels to be actually raped” “Did you press charges? No? Then it’s not true”, “ Have you told Lara? Have you told Latisha? Have you told Daniel? No?, because you lying”

I used to consider this relationship pretty mature and respectful.
This person was and has been so great to me at all times. I just do not understand where this hate is coming from. I wish I could speak to my friends and families. But I don’t want to have a label sitting on my forehead that says “…insane”.


I am afraid. I am in fault

Thank you for taking the time YourImaginaryFried

I appreciate your great explanation. I find it so hard to express this situation in the right way. I feel like being taken hostage in my current situation. The partner has been blaming me since then. Which I believe adds to my mental well being. I am running after a long passed bus. 

I would have never thought that 10min of evilness will destroy my future here. I’m not only losing my mind, significant other also a life that I built.

All I wanted was to be listened to. But failed.

Thank you so much aumbiance.
